messages:
Carla: FYI prod is seeing really weird tokenization in /v1/generate for model `redwood-xy-v1` after the deploy a few mins ago. Responses are fragmented and some prompts return empty strings. :frowning:
Ben: Can you paste the weights path and tokenizer hash? sounds like a tokenizer/weights mismatch. :eyes:
Carla: weights at s3://redwood-models/onboard/redwood-xy-v1/weights.tar.gz, sha256=6b1f3c9a...; tokenizer artifact at s3://redwood-models/onboard/redwood-xy-v1/tokenizer.json sha256=ea4d2a77...
Alice: Quick check — the runtime expects GPT-style BPE tokenizer by default. Did this model use sentencepiece?
Carla: The onboarding notes said "spm-based" but loader config in infra had `tokenizer: auto` so it might have picked the wrong fallback.
Dave: Also saw one node OOMed during load of the shard. Here's the kube log from node-gpu-23:
```
OOMKill: process 3421 invoked oom-killer
Model load failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
Allocated 14.2GB, available 12.8GB
```
Ben: OOM + tokenizer mismatch = plausible. If the tokenizer vocab differs, we can end up with huge token expansions causing memory spikes and weird outputs.
Alice: Can we validate tokenizer/schema on startup and refuse to bind a runtime if mismatch? e.g. check `vocab_size` and `model_family` entry in tokenizer.json before promoting to prod. Minimal patch: loader exits with clear error, and infra-bot can mark canary unhealthy.
Carla: For immediate mitigation: rolling back to previous stable model (redwood-xy-v0) or force the runtime to use model-provided tokenizer. Which is faster?
Ben: Rolling back is quickest. I'll trigger rollback if we decide. If you want a hotfix: set `TOKENIZER_PATH` env to the onboard tokenizer S3 URL so it won't `auto`-detect. That avoids code change.
Dave: I'll repro the OOM locally with the weights and smaller batch size. If the tokenizer expands tokens by >2x, that explains extra mem.
Alice: Patch idea for short-term: loader does a light validation step after download: check tokenizer type (spm vs bpe) and expected special tokens count. If mismatch, log and fail fast. I'll push a tiny PR against runtime today.
infra-bot: deploy 2026-02-12T14:12:30Z started by @Ben: rolling back redwood-xy-v1 -> redwood-xy-v0 :arrow_backward:
Carla: OK rolling back now. After that, let's treat this as postmortem item: "onboard validation: tokenizer+weights schema check" and add to eng-ml backlog.
Ben: Action items: 1) Rollback (in progress) 2) Dave to verify OOM cause 3) Alice to PR validation 4) Carla to add onboarding checklist step for tokenizer type. Ping me when rollback done. :thumbsup:
Carla: Rollback complete, traffic restored. Monitoring for 10m. Thanks all. :tada:
Ben: Great — please file a short incident note in /incidents and link the onboarding PR once ready.
Carla: Will do.
